$comment: Mirrors app.api.intel_schemas.OrgFactRecordRequest. Free-form key/value for org metadata that doesn't deserve its own table (Founded, EIN, Revenue, Parent company, etc.).
title: Intel Org Fact Record

source_name.description: Tool or agent that produced this record (e.g., 'osint-analyst', 'crunchbase-scraper').

notes.description: Analyst commentary, caveats, or follow-up questions about this fact.

authored_by.description: Attributed author of this interpretation; the backend fills a visible unknown when unavailable.

scope.description: Where this interpretation applies (for example engagement, host, surface, or identity). This is knowledge context, never authorization.

validity_context.description: Attributable prose describing when this interpretation was observed and what would require revalidation.

agent_name.description: Agent that retrieved or inferred this data.

artifact_ref.description: File or URL reference to the raw artifact (e.g., 'file:artifacts/crunchbase.html:42').

captured_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the data was captured.

command_run_id.description: Command-run audit row that produced this intel.

code_snapshot.description: Immutable source snapshot behind code-derived intel.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim excerpt from the source that supports this record.
